intent: Prevent shortcut input loss during MappingNotify refresh by retaining unchanged native grabs, installing missing combinations and then releasing obsolete grabs. Preserve conflict rollback, action precedence and active keyboard handoff; prove the original gap with a real XCB/XTEST barrier.
residual_risks: During binding changes, obsolete or rejected chords remain grabbed until final cleanup (X11Shortcuts.cpp:60). Input arriving in that narrow interval can be swallowed when dispatch checks the new grab list. This is a bounded reconciliation tradeoff, not loss of an unchanged accepted shortcut; incidence was not measured.
testing_gaps: The conflict test does not exercise an earlier-sorted action failing after retaining a native combination, followed by a later accepted action claiming that same combination. A focused case would directly cover the cleanup exemption at X11Shortcuts.cpp:60. Source inspection found the current logic preserves it.
